title: Grateful Dead Live at McNichols Sports Arena on 1981-07-14
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 05/2016
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM100/CP4 shotguns > unknown lead deck > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-Metal, FOB(?) recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality recording captures a killer July ’81 audience experience despite being only the first set.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates this upgrade of the first set four stars, calling the show “killer” and highlighting the iconic ’81 crowd that gives a strong ‘you are there’ feeling. While no specific technical flaws are noted, the audio is praised enough to be considered good, though the lack of a second‑set keeps it from a perfect rating.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review emphasizes strong performance and decent audio; limited data yields low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit technical complaints; reviewers note the recording conveys an iconic ’81 audience vibe, suggesting a clear enough capture of crowd ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is praised for its energy and atmosphere, though reviewer wishes it included a second set to reach full greatness.
